name: X-37B OTV-7 (USA-358, USSF-52)
payload: USA-358 / USSF-52; X-37B Orbital Test Vehicle (~5000 kg). Payloads largely classified.
first: USA-358 / USSF-52 — 434 days on orbit, Vandenberg SFB
description: Seventh X-37B flight — first to a highly-elliptical (HEO) orbit and first launched on Falcon Heavy. Launched 2023-12-29 01:07 UTC from KSC LC-39A; both side boosters recovered at LZ-1 / LZ-2, centre core expended for the HEO insertion energy. The HEO trajectory took the OTV to roughly the GEO belt altitude at apogee. Aerobraking manoeuvres in October 2024 lowered its orbit before the March 2025 de-orbit (USSF released a public update on the manoeuvres, a deliberate transparency departure from earlier classified flights). Landed at Vandenberg SFB 2025-03-07 07:22 UTC.

events.label: ON-ORBIT OPS
events.note: Apogee HEO ~38,800 km × ~320 km (first highly-elliptical OTV flight); classified payload operations.

events.label: LANDING
events.note: Autonomous runway landing at Vandenberg SFB 2025-03-07.
